title: bug: the VS Code board's Delete and Done-column clear never fire, because they ask window.confirm(), which the webview sandbox answers false, and the clear quotes the search-filtered column while ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS archives every DONE task in scope (twin of the DONE JetBrains fix 475e8844)
description:
Filed by defect hunt 11-03 #5 (task-b7332618). VS Code twin of task-475e8844 (JetBrains fix 76ca84ba). Today the count bug is masked by a VS Code-only defect: the confirmation never shows at all.

PROBLEM
1. Dead buttons.
- The board webview gates two actions on window.confirm(): the card menu's Delete (moe-vscode/media/board.js:318) and the Done column's clear button (board.js:1120-1125, archiveDone).
- VS Code's webview frames are sandboxed without allow-modals. microsoft/vscode main 73db368c, src/vs/workbench/contrib/webview/browser/webviewElement.ts:430, reads `element.sandbox.add('allow-scripts', 'allow-same-origin', 'allow-forms', 'allow-pointer-lock', 'allow-downloads')`. The inner frame's sandboxRules are in pre/index.html:1078-1086. `allow-modals` appears in neither file; local copies are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-b733/.
- In such a document confirm() returns false without showing anything (HTML Standard, "cannot show simple dialogs"), so both buttons silently do nothing.
- BoardViewProvider.ts:238-251 then sends DELETE_TASK / ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS unconditionally, so the dead webview confirm is the only gate.
- Every other VS Code confirmation is host-side, a `vscode.window.showWarningMessage(..., { modal: true }, ...)`: TaskDetailPanel.ts:517-519 (Delete), EpicDetailPanel.ts:119, AccountsTreeProvider.ts:240, ManagedVmTreeProvider.ts:46.

2. Wrong count.
- board.js:605-610 applies the board search to filteredTasks, and :621 builds each column from it.
- :626-627 (also :667 and :699) stamps the clear button with data-count = colTasks.length.
- archiveDone quotes that number and posts ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS with only the epic filter: board.js:1124 → BoardViewProvider.ts:246-248 → MoeDaemonClient.ts:1325-1326.
- The daemon archives `t.status === 'DONE' && (!epicFilter || t.epicId === epicFilter)` (packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:908-912) and never sees the search.
- Moving the confirmation host-side without fixing the count would archive more tasks than the dialog quotes.

EVIDENCE
All runs are on 19d5e67a (the moe/work-2026-10-24 tip, past 585fedc6), in a snapshot outside the checkout. The re-run recipe is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-b733/notes.md.

- NODE_PATH=/mnt/d/projexts/moes/moe-vscode/node_modules node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/zz-hunt-b733-board.test.cjs (the production board.js under node:vm; output in board.output.txt):
  - C1 is `not ok`. With 3 DONE tasks and the search "alpha", the dialog reads 'Archive 1 done task?' and the post is `[{"type":"archiveDoneTasks"}]`. That post carries no task list, so the daemon archives all 3.
  - C2 is `not ok`. With confirm() answering false, the clear posts nothing (`clearPosts: 0`).

- Chromium: headless Chrome on modal-probe.html, which nests VS Code's two sandbox token lists.
  - modal-probe.dom.txt: RESULT {"deleteConfirm":false,"archiveConfirm":false,"reopenPrompt":null}
  - modal-probe.stderr.txt, twice: "Ignored call to 'confirm()'. The document is sandboxed, and the 'allow-modals' keyword is not set."

FIX DIRECTION
- The webview posts only the intent: deleteTask with the taskId, archiveDoneTasks with the epic filter.
- BoardViewProvider asks with `vscode.window.showWarningMessage(text, { modal: true }, 'Delete' | 'Archive')`. It sends DELETE_TASK / ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS only for that answer; a dismissal sends nothing.
- Compute the archive count host-side at click time from daemonClient.currentState, using the daemon's own filter: status DONE, plus epicId = the filter when one is set, else the whole board. Quote that number; when it is 0, send nothing.
- JetBrains does the same with DoneColumnClear.archiveCount (76ca84ba).
- Remove window.confirm from board.js.

FILES
- moe-vscode/media/board.js: the card-menu Delete, archiveDone and the clear-button markup only.
- moe-vscode/src/providers/BoardViewProvider.ts: its deleteTask and archiveDoneTasks cases.
- one new moe-vscode/tests/*.test.cjs.

Hunk ownership, so no dependsOn is needed: task-3ab5be0d owns board.js navTask and BoardViewProvider's 'reopenTask' case. The gate snapshot must be the full tree: mem:gotcha-vscode-tests-need-full-repo-snapshot.
definitionOfDone: `grep -n "confirm(" moe-vscode/media/board.js` prints nothing. Delete and the Done-column clear post only their intent. BoardViewProvider sends DELETE_TASK / ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS only after a `{ modal: true }` vscode.window.showWarningMessage returns its confirming button; a dismissal sends nothing.

The archive dialog quotes the number of DONE tasks the daemon's ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS filter covers (the selected epic, else the whole board), whatever the board search hides. The host computes it from the client's current state at click time, and sends nothing when it is 0.

A new moe-vscode node test covers: Delete confirmed and dismissed; a clear while a search hides some DONE tasks (the quoted count is every DONE task in scope); and an epic-filtered clear. It runs the production media/board.js under node:vm and BoardViewProvider.ts transpiled, and it passes. `npm ci && npm test && npm run compile` passes in moe-vscode in a full-repo git-archive snapshot outside the checkout.

implementationPlan.description:
Extension host and changelog: moe-vscode/src/providers/BoardViewProvider.ts and moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md, copied with Edit from the same fix.diff hunks.

(a) Below the module's dbg() helper (line 15), add an exported module function:
`export function archiveDoneCount(tasks: ReadonlyArray<{ status?: unknown; epicId?: unknown }>, epicId: string | undefined): number`
It returns the number of tasks with status 'DONE' whose epicId equals epicId when one is given, else every DONE task. Give it a doc comment naming packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS, whose filter this is.

(b) After updateTaskStatus (line 91-100), add two private async methods, each with a doc comment.
- confirmDelete(taskId: unknown):
  - It returns at once unless taskId is a non-empty string.
  - It awaits `vscode.window.showWarningMessage(title ? `Delete "${title}"? This cannot be undone.` : 'Delete this task? This cannot be undone.', { modal: true }, 'Delete')`. The title is the task's title from daemonClient.currentState; these are the JetBrains moe.message.deleteTask words.
  - Only for 'Delete', and only while the provider is not disposed, does it call daemonClient.deleteTask(taskId).
- confirmArchiveDone(epicId: unknown):
  - scope = epicId when it is a non-empty string, else undefined.
  - count = archiveDoneCount(currentState.tasks or [], scope), counted at click time. When the count is 0 it returns without asking.
  - Otherwise it awaits `showWarningMessage(`Archive ${count} completed task(s)? They will be hidden from the board but remain on disk.`, { modal: true }, 'Archive')`; these are the JetBrains moe.message.archiveDone words.
  - Only for 'Archive', and only while not disposed, does it call daemonClient.archiveDoneTasks(scope).

(c) The 'deleteTask' and 'archiveDoneTasks' message cases (line 238-251) become `void this.confirmDelete(message.taskId); break;` and `void this.confirmArchiveDone(message.epicId); break;`.

(d) CHANGELOG.md: add one bullet at the TOP of [Unreleased] > ### Fixed. It must not go at the end: task-e9a25fbf appends there, and two insertions at the same place would conflict at landing. The bullet:
'- The board's **Delete** (card menu) and the Done column's clear button now ask in a VS Code modal and then act, as in JetBrains. Before, both did nothing, because a webview cannot show a confirmation dialog. The clear quotes every Done task it archives (the selected epic, else the whole board), not only the cards the board search shows.'

Error handling:
- Each method wraps its body in try/catch and reports a failure with `vscode.window.showErrorMessage('Failed to delete task: ...' / 'Failed to archive tasks: ...')`, the same messages the old cases used. The webview message handler is synchronous and drops promises, so an unhandled rejection there would be lost.
- A dismissed modal (undefined), any other answer, a provider disposed while the modal was open, and a malformed taskId/epicId all send nothing.

Run step 1's quick test command: 10/10 ok.
Afterwards, `LC_ALL=C grep -c -P '[^\x00-\x7F]' <file>` must still print board.js 6, BoardViewProvider.ts 1 and CHANGELOG.md 1, and the new test 0.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: The VS Code board's card-menu Delete and the Done column's clear button work. A VS Code webview's sandbox has no allow-modals, so window.confirm() there answers false, and the webview therefore posts only the intent: deleteTask with the taskId, or archiveDoneTasks with the selected epic, if any. BoardViewProvider then asks with a modal vscode.window.showWarningMessage worded as JetBrains: moe.message.deleteTask 'Delete "<title>"? This cannot be undone.', and moe.message.archiveDone 'Archive <n> completed task(s)? They will be hidden from the board but remain on disk.'. It sends DELETE_TASK / ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS only for the 'Delete' / 'Archive' answer. The archive count is what ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS archives: every DONE task in the epic filter, else on the whole board. It is counted from the client's current state at click time, whatever the board search hides. When it is 0, nothing is asked or sent.

The Done clear posts {type:'archiveDoneTasks'} (with epicId when an epic is selected) and opens no page dialog. When the search 'alpha' hides two of three DONE cards, the host still quotes 3.
An epic-filtered clear quotes and archives only that epic's DONE tasks. A clear with 0 DONE tasks in scope shows no modal and sends nothing. A dismissed modal sends nothing.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Keep the confirmation in the webview and only fix the count. Rejected: the webview cannot show the dialog at all. (2) Have the page send its visible count. Rejected: ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS never sees the search, so the host must count from the full state, as JetBrains does. (3) A custom in-webview confirmation overlay. Rejected: it is larger and inconsistent with every other VS Code confirmation, which are host modals. (4) Chosen: the page posts its intent, and the host asks in a modal using JetBrains' words.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: confirm() and prompt() are dead in every VS Code webview (mem:gotcha-vscode-webview-modals-blocked). board.js is a top-level script: its function declarations are context properties, selectedEpicFilter is a top-level let set through vm.runInContext, and searchQuery is a var. The provider's onDidReceiveMessage handler is synchronous, so the new async methods are fired with void and must catch their own errors.
